create_image_backend: create an ImageDocumentBackend to parse multi-page TIFF or single-frame image files
load_page_image: load a page from an image document and return an _ImagePageBackend instance
get_page_image_crop_scale: get a page image with optional cropbox and scale from _ImagePageBackend
get_bitmap_rects: get bitmap bounding boxes for a raw image page at a given scale
get_segmented_page: get an empty segmented page with proper dimensions for a raw image
